🛑 Requirement: Validate each fixture URL independently

The whitespace-only boundary includes unrelated content in the fixture pathname, so valid captured output such as `["https://github.com/example.invalid/hello/pull/1","feature%2Fbranch"]` blocks publication even though the URL itself passes validation. Adjacent Markdown links can trigger the same false rejection when the second link contains `%2F`. Extract individual URL spans before validation, preserving the owner-escape checks and captured output, and add regression cases for compact JSON and adjacent Markdown links.
Fixed in [6ceb78a](https://github.com/cli/cli/commit/6ceb78a575d98dbe06ac366e42501c67aee2b1c4). Both examples are covered in the existing publication table, with owner-escape checks retained.
